page.layout: One page of text, single column, centred dedicatory title above a verse poem; no margin notes; digitiser watermark at lower right (omitted).

main_text.head: FAMÆ ac VIRTUTI

p.i: Nobilissimi, Consultissimi, omniquè Eruditionis genere Consummatissimi Viri,

main_text.head: D. GERHARDI à MASTRICHT JCti, Antecessoris & Histor. Profess. Ordin. in Electoral. Universitat. Duisburgensi, Amici & Collegæ sui Honoratissimi,
CÙM
main_text.p: Adornatæ à se in Augustinum de Emend. Gratiani novæ Editioni subjungeret suam Juris Ecclesiastici Historiam.

page.notes: The initial S of the first verse is a large woodcut-style initial, joined as "SI". Several words in the poem are rendered in small capitals and italics as printed; the final word "Nunc" is set in a larger, different type. Ornamental dashes and specks on the scan are not text.
